items.title: Photos: India counts down to historic Moon landing
items.snippet_en: Al Jazeera reported on August 23, 2023, about widespread excitement in India for the Chandrayaan-3 moon landing, mentioning prayers, schools watching live telecasts, and space enthusiasts organizing parties.
Global News, via YouTube, published a video on August 23, 2023, showing people across India celebrating the successful Chandrayaan-3 landing with dancing, Indian flags, firecrackers, and drums.

items.title: Chandrayaan-3: India celebrates landing craft on the Moon — in pictures
items.snippet_en: The National News published an article on August 23, 2023, with pictures of jubilant scenes across India following the successful landing of the Vikram craft near the lunar south pole.

Alamy shows images of BJP party leaders, workers and the general public celebrating the successful lunar landing of the Chandrayaan-3 spacecraft on the south pole of the Moon, in Agartala, Tripura, India.

items.title: No, BBC did not criticize Chandrayaan-3; old clip viral, false report by Times Now, India TV, Zee News, other outlets
items.snippet_en: Alt News reported on August 25, 2023, that a viral video claiming to be a BBC reaction to Chandrayaan-2 (not Chandrayaan-3) was an old clip from 2019.

items.title: Fact Check: Viral pic of Earth from Moon surface, claimed to be from Chandrayaan-3, is AI-generated
items.snippet_en: India TV News published a fact-check on August 29, 2023, stating that a widely shared photo of Earth from the Moon's surface, claimed to be from Chandrayaan-3, was actually AI-generated.

Several Facebook posts from August 28, 2023, discuss reports and fact-checks debunking claims that certain "live visuals" or videos of the moon from Chandrayaan-3 were fabricated or compilations of unrelated old footage.

items.title: WebQoof: Live Visuals of Moon From ISRO's Chandrayaan-3? Here's a Fact-Check
items.snippet_en: Articles from The Quint on August 28, 2023, discuss reports and fact-checks debunking claims that certain "live visuals" or videos of the moon from Chandrayaan-3 were fabricated or compilations of unrelated old footage.

outputs.notes_en: Multiple sources confirm that people across India celebrated the Chandrayaan-3 Moon landing on August 23, 2023, with various forms of public celebration. Some sources also indicate that certain visuals circulated online related to Chandrayaan-3 were not authentic, but these refer to different media than the general celebration images.
